description: React component for a Business Loan Applicant Portal with draft management, document upload, and application submission features.

methods.name: prettyJson
methods.description: Formats a value as pretty JSON string, with error handling.

methods.name: safeJsonStr
methods.description: Converts a value to JSON string or returns original if string.

methods.name: shortId
methods.description: Returns last 6 characters of an ID in uppercase, or placeholder.

methods.name: statusTheme
methods.description: Returns color theme based on draft status.

methods.name: addToast
methods.description: Adds a toast notification with message and type.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an async function with loading state and error handling.

methods.name: fetchDrafts
methods.description: Fetches list of drafts from API.

methods.name: fetchDocs
methods.description: Fetches documents linked to a draft.

methods.name: doCreateDraft
methods.description: Creates a new draft via API.

methods.name: doPatchSection
methods.description: Saves a draft section with JSON payload.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Uploads a document linked to current draft.

methods.name: doCheckReadiness
methods.description: Checks if draft is ready for submission.

methods.name: doLogout
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login.
